text:
Marta (Product): quick huddle — Polaris wants a private pilot with BYOK, prewarm, and a firm SLA: p99 < 300ms. need a sequenced dependency map and owners. who has the longest lead?
Owen (PM): customer timeline is 4 weeks. acceptance: p99 <300ms, successful key rotation, and a 1-week canary with 3 tenants.
Kai (Runtime): runtime asks: prewarm hook + tenant-scoped KV + graceful fallback to hosted model. prewarm needs infra to signal GPU allocation ~3m before traffic. we'll need a health endpoint for routing.
Vik (Infra): infra side: VPC peering, reserved GPU quota, and firewall rules to allow KMS egress. quota bump is likely the longest (could be 7-10bd). peering prep can start now but final apply waits on security clearance.
Sana (Security): BYOK review is the gating item. need vendor attestation, key usage policy, rotation plan, and an IAM matrix. estimate 7-8 business days once we receive vendor packet. peering approval is blocked until attestation is satisfied.
Diego (Eng): engineering: build feature flag for tenant isolation + automated tests + console toggle for canary percentage. estimate ~2.5w. we can mock KMS for unit tests while security runs.
Ruth (SRE): SRE needs tenant-level SLOs, synthetic cold-start probes, and an automated rollback policy. proposal: start canary at 2% traffic, monitor p50/p95/p99, auto-fallback if p99 > 300ms for 10m. also need token-level cost logs to validate unit economics.
Marta (Product): sounds like critical path = vendor attestation -> quota approval -> runtime integration. can we parallelize reviews?
Sana (Security): yes, we can start documentation review and threat model in parallel, but we can't sign off network creds without vendor attestation. that piece is serial.
Vik (Infra): i'll open the quota and peering tickets now and tag cloud-ops; will mark peering as awaiting security.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-POLARIS-721 by Vik.
Vik (Infra): ticket created and linked here. adding expected GPU count and requested CIDRs.
Kai (Runtime): i'll spike a prewarm shim today. health endpoint proto: ```GET /tenant/{tid}/warm -> {"warm":true|false, "kv_prefetch":"done|in_progress"}``` routing can read warm and decide to keep traffic on private path.
Diego (Eng): will wire feature flag to the mock endpoint and add integration tests. posting RFC link by EOD.
Owen (PM): asked Polaris to upload vendor attestation and CIDRs. they said they'd try to deliver in 48h.
Ruth (SRE): note on rollback: if fallback is triggered we should route only that tenant to hosted variant, keep others on private. also generate an immediate alert to oncall.
Kai (Runtime): agree. will add per-tenant routing key and a small health-check metric that SRE can scrape.
Sana (Security): callout: if vendor attestation lacks SOC2/SOC3 equivalency we'll need extra paperwork — that could add 2+ weeks. recommend contingency: hosted BYOK shim for early validation.
Marta (Product): contingency accepted. product to propose hosted BYOK shim if attestation stalls.
Vik (Infra): cloud quota request submitted. cloud-ops responded: ~5bd estimate. this looks like another serial blocker if cloud account team requires manual approval. pinging them for expedited path.
Diego (Eng): RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/polaris-tenant-isolation (contains tests and rollout steps).
Kai (Runtime): spike doc: https://redwood.internal/spikes/polaris-prewarm (includes cache invalidation notes and health endpoint proto).
Owen (PM): action items recap: 1) Sana: start BYOK attestation review when packet arrives (7-8bd). 2) Vik: quota + peering tickets (quota est 5bd). 3) Kai/Diego: mock prewarm + RFC (EOW). 4) Ruth: runbook + canary thresholds (2bd). 5) Marta/Owen: confirm acceptance criteria and runbook with Polaris (2bd). please ack with :white_check_mark:.
Ruth (SRE): ack :white_check_mark:. will post runbook stub + alert thresholds tomorrow.
Sana (Security): ack :white_check_mark:. started drafting threat model.
Vik (Infra): ack :white_check_mark:. will update ticket with cloud-ops replies.
Diego (Eng): ack :white_check_mark:. will post test results against mocks.
Kai (Runtime): ack :white_check_mark:. will add warm-metrics to the spike.
Marta (Product): thanks. next sync Fri 9am to confirm attestation arrival and quota status. if vendor attestation or quota approvals stall we'll escalate to execs. react :thumbsup: when you've seen this.
